mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below its 12-month moving average signals accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% YoY), supply chain bottlenecks ease and corporate capacity utilization rises, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 1.5% YoY, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals weak consumer confidence and reduced residential investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200 thousand signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS > 200, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal an active monetary tightening cycle to combat inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS increase, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), labor market tightness increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as inflation expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
